slider.label: Moon visibility at horizon
slider.name: moon_horizon_min_opacity
slider.tool_tip: Minimum opacity of the moon disc at the horizon. 0.00 reproduces the legacy fade; 1.00 disables horizon dimming. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon brightness multiplier
slider.name: moon_brightness_multiplier
slider.tool_tip: Multiplies the current environment's moon-disc brightness without modifying the environment asset. 1.00 preserves its original brightness. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon phase
slider.name: moon_phase
slider.tool_tip: Viewer-local moon phase: 0.00 New, 0.25 First quarter, 0.50 Full, 0.75 Last quarter, 1.00 New. The illuminated fraction also scales moon god rays. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon phase curvature
slider.name: moon_phase_curvature
slider.tool_tip: Nonlinearly reshapes the moon terminator. 1.00 is spherical; higher and lower values provide artistic curve control. Quarter, full, and new moons remain exact. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon phase softness
slider.name: moon_phase_softness
slider.tool_tip: Width of the nonlinear transition centered on the geometric phase boundary. 0.000 keeps only pixel antialiasing. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon phase tilt (degrees)
slider.name: moon_phase_tilt
slider.tool_tip: Rotates the crescent and phase terminator around the moon disc. Positive angles rotate counterclockwise; 0 preserves the vertical terminator. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon terminator relief
slider.name: moon_terminator_relief_strength
slider.tool_tip: Directional crater-detail contrast near the phase boundary. 0.00 disables it. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Terminator relief width
slider.name: moon_terminator_relief_width
slider.tool_tip: Width of the enhanced crater-detail band around the phase boundary. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon earthshine
slider.name: moon_earthshine_strength
slider.tool_tip: Minimum moon texture visibility blended over the sky on the shadowed side. 0.00 fully reveals the sky. It does not contribute to halo or god rays. Changes are applied live.

color_swatch.name: moon_horizon_tint
color_swatch.tool_tip: Color multiplied into the moon disc near the horizon. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon horizon color strength
slider.name: moon_horizon_tint_strength
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the warm moon tint at the horizon. 0.00 disables the effect; the tint smoothly disappears as the moon rises. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon horizon color angle
slider.name: moon_horizon_tint_angle
slider.tool_tip: Moon elevation in degrees at which the horizon color has fully faded. Changes are applied live.

check_box.label: Enable moon halo
check_box.name: moon_halo_enabled
check_box.tool_tip: Render the viewer-local atmospheric halo around the moon. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon halo strength
slider.name: moon_halo_strength
slider.tool_tip: Strength of the circular, phase-attenuated atmospheric halo. Moon brightness also scales it through a calibrated saturating response. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon halo radius
slider.name: moon_halo_radius
slider.tool_tip: Outer halo radius measured in moon-disc radii. Changes are applied live.

slider.label: Moon halo softness
slider.name: moon_halo_softness
slider.tool_tip: Width of the halo's radial falloff in moon-disc radii. Changes are applied live.
